question: A mobile phone is marked at ₹30,000. Successive discounts of 20% and 10% are applied. What is the final selling price?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount % = a + b − (a × b ÷ 100) = 20 + 10 − (20 × 10 ÷ 100) = 28%.

Selling Price = 100% − 28% = 72% of **Marked Price**.

SP = 30,000 × 0.72 = 21,600.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹ 21,600.**
